description:
Bring photos and supported videos from compatible Panasonic Image App-era cameras straight to your iPhone. GM1 Sync is an independent alternative to Image App that connects directly to the camera's Wi-Fi network and shows the SD card as a gallery.

ONE CAMERA MODE
On the Panasonic DMC-GM1S, use Wi-Fi → New Connection → Remote Shooting & View → Direct → Image App. The same connection handles browsing, previews, and supported original downloads.

BROWSE AND IMPORT
• Browse the complete camera card
• Open photo and supported MP4 previews
• Import JPEG, JPEG + RAW, RAW-only, and supported MP4 originals
• Select one item, a batch, or all new items
• See which filenames already exist in Apple Photos when read access is granted

OPTIONAL GEOTAGGING
Start a visible location log before shooting. During import, GM1 Sync can match the camera's EXIF capture time to a nearby track point and add that location to the Apple Photos asset. Location data stays on the iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There are no accounts, ads, analytics, trackers, or cloud uploads. Camera traffic stays on the direct local Wi-Fi connection.

COMPATIBILITY
The Panasonic DMC-GM1S is the primary validated camera. The GM1, GM5, and other Panasonic Image App-era models are potential candidates but may vary by model and firmware. AVCHD transfer is unavailable when the camera advertises a media URL that its server does not provide.

GM1 Sync is independent software and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Panasonic. Panasonic, LUMIX, and Image App are trademarks of their respective owners.
promotionalText: An independent Image App alternative for browsing and importing photos and supported videos from compatible classic Lumix cameras.
